messages.author: Marisol Okafor
messages.text: Two decks quote 'payer conversion' as 2.1% and 1.7% for the same period. Which one is right?

replies.author: Ingrid Solberg
replies.text: Both, they measure different things :sweat_smile: The ~2% is *cohort payer conversion D7*: share of installers who paid within 7 days (mature D7 cohorts, from cohorts.payers_d7). The ~1.7% is the *daily payer rate*: paying users / DAU, game-wide by platform from daily_kpis. Our default meaning of 'payer conversion' is the cohort D7 one.

replies.author: Marisol Okafor
replies.text: Please make every deck say which one it is.

replies.author: Ingrid Solberg
replies.text: Added a line to the weekly report template. Also heads-up: the *Marketing KPI Glossary* page in the Leads space still describes payer conversion as payers/DAU. *Metric Definitions (v3)* is the canonical one.
